description:
HushPinterest v0.0.13: 33 patches for Pinterest 14.41.0, which needs Android 12L or newer. This one adds GmsCore support for phones that use microG-RE instead of Google Play services, so Google sign-in and push notifications go through microG-RE. It isn't picked by default. The patches are now built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0. Validation: 1069 runtime tests passed. All 241 patch tests passed. All 33 patches applied without forcing to Pinterest 14.41.0. Needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. Uninstall the stock app first, then sign in with your email and a Pinterest password.

### What's new

* **Pinterest:** New GmsCore support patch, for phones that run microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Pinterest's Google sign-in and push notifications go through microG-RE, so Continue with Google opens microG-RE's sign-in. Before, it asked Play services and the account got turned down. It's left out of the default selection since without microG-RE those requests have nowhere to go. Pick it in Expert mode and Spoof signature for Google sign-in comes along with it. (#15)
* **Pinterest:** The patches are now built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer to apply them. Older Manager builds can't load the bundle.
